output.reason: An inversion ankle injury last night with lateral swelling and bruising but preserved partial weight-bearing can be managed with home measures and an action-based safety net, with no reported feature requiring clinician assessment, imaging or prescribing now.
output.patientMessage: Home care is reasonable now: rest, ice, a compression wrap, elevation and over-the-counter pain relief for a rolled ankle you can still bear some weight on. Get in-person assessment the same day if you become unable to bear weight, or develop numbness, tingling, coldness or worsening swelling in the foot. Message this thread for clinician review if pain isn't improving over the next week.
differential: Lateral ankle ligament sprain from inversion injury
Undetected lateral malleolus or avulsion fracture

redFlags.concern: Numbness, tingling or coldness in the foot
